rationale: Polishes floor navigation and the phone header already present in stable v1.82.0. The existing tabs consume too much width; reuse the UI Kit select at an actual header width of 1024 px or less while preserving existing navigation, permissions and wide tabs. No new saved capability or model field.

summary.ru: На узкой шапке этаж выбирается из компактного списка; настройки, масштаб и обычное переключение сохранены.
summary.en: Narrow headers use a compact floor selector while retaining settings, zoom and ordinary navigation.

golden.reason: New phone header frame with the existing 44 px UI Kit field, a clipped long floor title and available gear/zoom commands.
New dark narrow-card frame with the real shared popup open and full floor names visible within the viewport.
